zh.title: postmarketOS / Nura：旧手机 Linux 路线
zh.summary: 项目资料不以 GitHub 为中心；下载入口目前跳转到 Nura，设备资料和代码仍分布在 Wiki 与 GitLab。
zh.gap: KitAgain 尚未梳理品牌迁移、当前支持等级、通话/相机等功能矩阵，也没有针对具体手机完成实机验证。
zh.next_check: 选 3 个具体旧机型，逐一核对设备页、安装方法、主线内核状态和恢复路径。
zh.safety: 刷写前必须按准确代号核对；同品牌相近型号不能互换镜像。

en.title: postmarketOS / Nura: Linux routes for older phones
en.summary: The project is not GitHub-centered. Its download entry currently redirects to Nura, while device material and code remain distributed across a wiki and GitLab.
en.gap: KitAgain has not yet reconciled the brand migration, current support levels, calling/camera matrices, or a tested route for any exact phone.
en.next_check: Select three exact older models and review each device page, installation route, mainline-kernel status and recovery path.
en.safety: Match the exact device codename before flashing; similar retail names do not make images interchangeable.

zh.title: Libreboot：非 GitHub 托管的开源固件路线
zh.summary: 官方文档和构建系统托管在自有网站与 Codeberg，并列出大量具体主板和安装路径。
zh.gap: 项目资料较完整，但 KitAgain 尚未把支持主板、内部/外部刷写条件、许可证范围和恢复设备逐项整理成正式条目。
zh.next_check: 从一个具体 ThinkPad 或 Chromebook 板号开始，核对 ROM、刷写方式、备份和回退。
zh.safety: 这是固件写入操作。官方要求先备份当前闪存，并明确警告错误操作可能导致设备无法启动。

en.title: Libreboot: open firmware hosted outside GitHub
en.summary: Official documentation and the build system live on the project site and Codeberg, with board-specific install paths.
en.gap: The upstream material is substantial, but KitAgain has not yet converted supported boards, internal/external flashing, license scope and recovery equipment into a reviewed catalog entry.
en.next_check: Start with one exact ThinkPad or Chromebook board and verify its ROM, flashing method, backup and rollback.
en.safety: This writes boot firmware. Upstream requires a flash backup and warns that incorrect steps can leave the machine unable to boot.

zh.title: Kirkwood 旧 NAS 安装 Debian / U-Boot
zh.summary: 长期维护资料主要存在 Doozan 论坛帖和回复中，覆盖部分 Zyxel、Seagate、Synology、Pogoplug 等设备。
zh.gap: 不是一个统一镜像覆盖所有 NAS；型号、SoC、原厂 U-Boot、串口、NAND 布局和当前下载包需要逐帖核对。
zh.next_check: 选 NSA325、GoFlex Home、DS211 各一条主帖，记录当前 rootfs、U-Boot、校验值与恢复步骤。
zh.safety: 部分路径会覆盖原厂固件；没有串口和闪存备份时不应执行写入步骤。

en.title: Debian and U-Boot for older Kirkwood NAS devices
en.summary: Long-running material lives mainly in Doozan forum threads and replies, covering selected Zyxel, Seagate, Synology and Pogoplug devices.
en.gap: There is no universal image for every NAS. Model, SoC, stock U-Boot, serial access, NAND layout and current downloads require thread-by-thread review.
en.next_check: Review one primary thread each for NSA325, GoFlex Home and DS211, recording current rootfs, U-Boot, checksums and recovery.
en.safety: Some routes overwrite stock firmware; do not write flash without serial access and a verified backup.

zh.title: Rebble：Pebble 停服后的社区服务路线
zh.summary: 官方 HOWTO、帮助中心、Discord 和项目页共同维持旧 Pebble 手表的设置、应用商店与部分云服务。
zh.gap: 当前又出现新的 Pebble 应用与服务路径；KitAgain 尚未核对旧版 Android/iOS、各表型、付费服务和固件组合。
zh.next_check: 按 Pebble Classic、Time、Pebble 2 和手机系统分别整理当前配对、应用安装、服务依赖与取消路径。
zh.safety: 不要把恢复出厂设置当作第一步；先保存当前能工作的手机应用、固件和配对状态。

en.title: Rebble: community services after Pebble shutdown
en.summary: An official HOWTO, help center, Discord and project pages collectively support setup, an app store and selected cloud services for older Pebble watches.
en.gap: New Pebble app and service paths now coexist. KitAgain has not reconciled legacy Android/iOS versions, watch families, paid services and firmware combinations.
en.next_check: Map current pairing, app installation, service dependencies and exit paths for Pebble Classic, Time and Pebble 2 across phone platforms.
en.safety: Do not start with a factory reset. Preserve the currently working phone app, firmware and pairing state first.

zh.title: Jelloid：把旧 Android 设备变成 Jellyfin 服务器
zh.summary: 作者在 Instructables 发布完整步骤，并称在多台 Motorola、Pixel 和 Fire Tablet 上测试。
zh.gap: KitAgain 尚未独立复现，也未确认脚本的长期维护、许可证、Android 版本范围、转码能力和后台保活限制。
zh.next_check: 保存脚本来源和许可证，列出五类已报告设备的 Android/架构，并在一台闲置设备上做安装与重启验收。
zh.safety: 服务器会接触媒体文件和局域网；测试前使用副本，并检查应用来源、端口与权限。

en.title: Jelloid: use an older Android device as a Jellyfin server
en.summary: The author published a step-by-step Instructable and reports tests on several Motorola devices, a Pixel and a Fire tablet.
en.gap: KitAgain has not reproduced it or confirmed script maintenance, licensing, Android range, transcoding capability or background-process limits.
en.next_check: Preserve the script source and license, map reported devices to Android/architecture, then test install and reboot on one spare device.
en.safety: The server accesses media and the local network. Test with copies and review package origin, ports and permissions.

zh.title: 拆机 Kindle 屏幕转接板
zh.summary: Hackaday 项目记录了 39 针墨水屏的高压驱动、转接板和 ESP 控制实验，并有一次黑白显示成功日志。
zh.gap: 项目多年未更新，屏幕连接器和波形高度依型号而异；作者也记录过因早期板卡问题损坏屏幕。
zh.next_check: 核对具体面板编号、PCB 修订、BOM、代码许可证和是否还有可制造文件。
zh.safety: 驱动包含多路正负高压；错接可能损坏面板，不适合作为通用 Kindle 改造教程。

en.title: Adapter board for salvaged Kindle displays
en.summary: A Hackaday project documents high-voltage drive rails, an adapter PCB and ESP experiments for 39-pin e-paper panels, including a successful black-and-white output log.
en.gap: The project has been quiet for years, connectors and waveforms vary by panel, and the author recorded a screen damaged during an earlier board attempt.
en.next_check: Verify exact panel numbers, PCB revision, BOM, code license and the availability of manufacturable files.
en.safety: The driver uses multiple positive and negative high-voltage rails. Incorrect wiring can destroy a panel; this is not a universal Kindle guide.

zh.title: 6 英寸 Kindle 屏幕转 Raspberry Pi：未完成原型
zh.summary: 目标是制作树莓派到闲置 Kindle 屏幕的接口板；作者公开记录两版 PCB 都有错误、无法工作，后来转向参考另一项目。
zh.gap: 没有可复现的成功硬件、最终 BOM 或验收结果。这条线索的价值在于保存失败原因和项目关系。
zh.next_check: 只在找到后继硬件或可验证的修订后升级；当前与 L06 建立关联，不把它写成成功案例。
zh.safety: 不要按失败 PCB 直接下单或接屏；先核对后继设计与面板电气要求。

en.title: Six-inch Kindle display for Raspberry Pi: incomplete prototype
en.summary: The goal was a Raspberry Pi interface for a surplus Kindle panel. The author records that two PCB revisions contained errors and were unusable, then switched to another project.
en.gap: There is no reproducible successful board, final BOM or acceptance result. Its value is preserving failure evidence and project relationships.
en.next_check: Upgrade only if a successor board or verifiable revision appears; link it to L06 and do not present it as a successful build.
en.safety: Do not order or connect the failed PCB design without checking a successor and the exact panel electrical requirements.

zh.title: 旧平板作为 Home Assistant 墙面板
zh.summary: 多个社区帖子记录用旧 Android 平板、Kiosk 浏览器或二手触屏设备展示 Home Assistant 仪表板。
zh.gap: 这是一类分散经验，不是单一软件包；浏览器内核、Android 版本、充电策略、挂墙散热和长期电池安全差异很大。
zh.next_check: 按具体平板型号收集浏览器版本、充电限制、重启恢复和 30 天运行记录，再形成正式指南。
zh.safety: 已有社区作者报告长期插电后电池膨胀；旧电池、隐蔽布线和持续充电必须单独评估。

en.title: Older tablets as Home Assistant wall panels
en.summary: Community threads document older Android tablets, kiosk browsers and second-hand touch devices used for Home Assistant dashboards.
en.gap: This is a distributed pattern rather than one package. Browser engines, Android versions, charging control, wall cooling and long-term battery safety vary widely.
en.next_check: Collect browser version, charge limits, reboot recovery and 30-day operation for exact tablet models before producing a formal guide.
en.safety: A community author reports a battery swelling under long-term charging. Old batteries, concealed wiring and continuous power require separate review.

zh.title: 用 Raspberry Pi 改造故障 Sonos Play:1
zh.summary: Raspberry Pi 官方教程拆除原主板，保留扬声器与外壳，加入 Pi、DAC 和功放，并提供后续软件路线。
zh.gap: KitAgain 尚未核对不同 Sonos 修订、供电/功放匹配、完整成本和教程内容许可，也没有实机复现。
zh.next_check: 以 Play:1 的具体硬件修订整理拆机、扬声器阻抗、独立电源、音频软件和验收项。
zh.safety: 原机使用市电，主板电容可能残留危险电压；这不是无经验用户的低风险拆机项目。

en.title: Upcycle a failed Sonos Play:1 with Raspberry Pi
en.summary: An official Raspberry Pi tutorial removes the original mainboard, keeps the enclosure and drivers, and adds a Pi, DAC and amplifier with follow-up software routes.
en.gap: KitAgain has not checked Sonos hardware revisions, power/amplifier matching, full cost or tutorial licensing, and has not reproduced the build.
en.next_check: For one exact Play:1 revision, document disassembly, driver impedance, isolated power, audio software and acceptance checks.
en.safety: The original unit uses mains power and board capacitors may retain dangerous voltage. This is not a low-risk first disassembly project.

zh.title: ESP32 蓝牙接收器复用旧音响
zh.summary: 作者用 ESP32、VS1053 和外置天线让旧音响接收手机蓝牙音频，并链接两套实现代码与演示。
zh.gap: KitAgain 尚未核对代码许可证、音频质量、延迟、供电噪声、不同功放输入和长期维护。
zh.next_check: 核对两种板卡的引脚/BOM/许可证，并在带线路输入的旧音响上做可回退测试。
zh.safety: 优先使用外部低压线路输入；涉及市电机内改线时需要额外隔离和电气安全评估。

en.title: ESP32 Bluetooth receiver for an older stereo
en.summary: The author uses an ESP32, VS1053 and external antenna to stream phone audio to an older stereo, linking two code variants and a demonstration.
en.gap: KitAgain has not checked code licensing, audio quality, latency, supply noise, amplifier inputs or long-term maintenance.
en.next_check: Verify pinouts, BOM and licenses for both board variants, then run a reversible test through a stereo line input.
en.safety: Prefer an external low-voltage line input. Any internal mains wiring requires separate isolation and electrical-safety review.
